rule_requirement: Establishes the statutory authority for Part 1 of the CPA Rules under C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) and 6-1-1313
If any provision of these Colorado Privacy Act Rules (4 CCR 904-3) is found invalid the remaining provisions remain in full force and effect
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1303 6-1-1313) and purpose to define undefined terms used throughout the CPA and these Rules; defined terms are capitalized

Defines terms in addition to C.R.S. § 6-1-1303 including Authorized Agent; Automated Processing; Biometric Data; Biometric Identifiers; Bona Fide Loyalty Program; Bona Fide Loyalty Program Benefit; Data Broker; Data Right; Disability; Human Involved Automated Processing; Human Reviewed Automated Processing; Intimate Image; Opt-Out Purpose; Publicly Available Information; Revealing; Sensitive Data Inference; Solely Automated Processing; Universal Opt-Out Mechanism
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) and 6-1-1313) and purpose to ensure disclosures notifications and other communications to Consumers are clear accessible and understandable

rule_name: Requirements for Disclosures Notifications and Other Communications to Consumers
rule_requirement: Disclosures must be understandable and accessible to target audiences; accessible to Consumers with Disabilities (e.g. WCAG 2.1); available in relevant languages; provided through a regularly used interface; readable on all devices
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1306 6-1-1313) and purpose to clarify the scope of Consumer Personal Data rights and processes to exercise them

rule_name: Submitting Requests to Exercise Personal Data Rights
rule_requirement: Governs the methods and requirements Controllers must provide for Consumers to submit requests to exercise their Data Rights
Governs the Consumer right to opt out of Targeted Advertising Sale of Personal Data and Profiling and how Controllers must facilitate it
Governs the Consumer right to confirm processing and access their Personal Data
Governs the Consumer right to correct inaccuracies in their Personal Data
Governs the Consumer right to delete Personal Data and related retention exceptions
Governs the Consumer right to obtain Personal Data in a portable and readily usable format
Governs how Controllers must authenticate Consumers and Authorized Agents submitting Data Rights requests
Governs Controller obligations and timelines for responding to Consumer Data Rights requests
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1306 6-1-1313) and purpose for Universal Opt-Out Mechanism rules
Specifies the rights (opt out of Targeted Advertising and Sale) that a Universal Opt-Out Mechanism exercises
Requires providers of Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms to give Consumers notice and choice regarding the mechanism
Governs default settings for Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms so they reflect the Consumer's affirmative choice
Limits how providers of Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms may use Personal Data collected through the mechanism
Sets technical specifications for Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms

rule_name: System for Recognizing Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms
rule_requirement: Establishes the process and public list for recognizing Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms
Sets Controller obligations to recognize and honor Universal Opt-Out Mechanisms
Governs when a Controller may obtain Consent to process after a Consumer has opted out via a Universal Opt-Out Mechanism
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1308 6-1-1313) and purpose for the duties of Controllers rules
Sets principles that Controller privacy notices must satisfy
Specifies the required content of a Controller privacy notice including categories of Personal Data purposes third parties and Consumer rights
Governs how Controllers must handle and communicate changes to a privacy notice
Governs Bona Fide Loyalty Programs including required disclosures and Consent
Requires Controllers to specify the express purposes for which Personal Data is collected and processed
Requires Personal Data collection and processing to be adequate relevant and limited to what is reasonably necessary to the specified purposes
Governs processing of Personal Data for purposes not reasonably necessary to or compatible with the originally specified purposes and requires new Consent
Establishes the Controller duty of care to secure Personal Data during storage and use
Governs the Controller duty regarding Sensitive Data including opt-in Consent and Sensitive Data Inferences
Requires Controllers to create and maintain documentation demonstrating compliance with their duties
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1303(5) 6-1-1306 6-1-1313) and purpose for the Consent rules
Identifies the circumstances in which a Controller must obtain Consumer Consent
Consent must be a clear affirmative act that is freely given specific informed and unambiguous and not obtained through Dark Patterns
Governs how Controllers must present requests for Consent to Consumers
Governs when a Controller may request Consent after a Consumer has opted out
Governs obtaining Consent for the processing of a Child's Personal Data
Requires Controllers to provide an easy means for Consumers to refuse or withdraw Consent
Governs when Controllers must refresh (re-obtain) Consumer Consent

rule_name: User Interface Design Choice Architecture and Dark Patterns
rule_requirement: Prohibits the use of Dark Patterns and governs user interface design and choice architecture used to obtain Consent
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1309 6-1-1313) and purpose for the Data Protection Assessment rules
Defines the processing activities that present a heightened risk of harm and require a Data Protection Assessment
Requires involvement of relevant internal and external stakeholders in Data Protection Assessments
Specifies the required content of a Data Protection Assessment including benefits risks and safeguards
Governs when Data Protection Assessments must be conducted reviewed and updated
Governs how Controllers must make Data Protection Assessments available to the Attorney General upon request
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) 6-1-1306 6-1-1309) and purpose for the Profiling rules
Defines the scope of Profiling covered including Solely Automated Human Reviewed and Human Involved Automated Processing
Requires Controllers to provide transparency about Profiling and the right to opt out

rule_name: Opting Out of Profiling in Furtherance of Decisions That Produce Legal or Similarly Significant Effects Concerning a Consumer
rule_requirement: Governs the Consumer right to opt out of Profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects

rule_name: Consent for Profiling in Furtherance of Decisions That Produce Legal or Similarly Significant Effects Concerning a Consumer
rule_requirement: Governs when Consent is required for Profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects
Requires and specifies Data Protection Assessments for Profiling activities
Establishes authority (C.R.S. §§ 6-1-108(1) and 6-1-1313) and purpose for materials incorporated by reference
Incorporates by reference the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.1 (June 5 2018) from the World Wide Web Consortium
